title: TransactionResponse
description: Complete transaction information including status, amounts, blockchain info, and timestamps.

simulationId.description: ID of the simulation used to create this transaction.

integratorId.description: ID of the integrator who initiated the transaction.

beneficiaryId.description: ID of the beneficiary involved in the transaction.

AccountDetailsDto.description:
Container for different types of bank account details supporting multiple payment rails. Each property corresponds to a specific payment method:
- wireDetails: Wire transfer account details for domestic U.S. transfers
- achDetails: ACH (Automated Clearing House) account details for U.S. electronic transfers
- swiftDetails: SWIFT international wire transfer account details
- pixDetails: PIX account details for instant payments in Brazil
- copDetails: Colombian Peso (COP) account details for transfers in Colombia
- speiDetails: SPEI account details for electronic transfers in Mexico
- cvuDetails: CVU (Clave Virtual Uniforme) account details for transfers in Argentina

AchAccountDto.description:
ACH account information for electronic fund transfers in the United States.
- personInfo: Personal information for individual account holders
- bankInfo: Bank identification and routing information (required)
- businessInfo: Business information for corporate account holders

AchBankInfo.description: Bank information for ACH transfers including routing details and bank address.

routingNumber.description: 9-digit ABA routing number identifying the bank.

name.description: Full legal name of the financial institution.

street1.description: Primary street address of the bank.

name.description: Legal business name of the company.

city.description: City where the business is located.

accountNumber.description: Bank account number for ACH transfers.

name.description: Full name of the account holder.

routingKey.description: Routing key for the account (routing number).

AmountDto.description: Represents a monetary amount with currency code and value.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code or cryptocurrency ticker symbol.

value.description: The monetary amount in the specified currency. Precision depends on the currency (typically 2 decimal places for fiat, up to 8 for crypto).

AmountFourDecimalPlacesResponse.description: Monetary amount with up to four decimal places precision, typically used for fee calculations and exchange rate conversions.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code or cryptocurrency ticker symbol.

value.description: The monetary amount with up to 4 decimal places of precision.

BankInfo.description: Bank information including BIC/SWIFT code and address details for international wire transfers.

bic.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) or SWIFT code - 8 or 11 character code identifying the bank.

name.description: Full legal name of the bank.

street1.description: Primary street address line of the bank.

BusinessInfo.description: Business account information for wire transfers including company details and bank account information.

name.description: Legal business name of the company.

address.description: Street address of the business headquarters.

city.description: City where the business is located.

accountNumber.description: Business bank account number for wire transfers.

routingNumber.description: 9-digit ABA routing number or SWIFT code.

registrationNumber.description: Business registration or tax ID number (EIN/Tax ID).

registrationDate.description: Date when the business was registered.

registrationExpiryDate.description: Expiry date of business registration (if applicable).

mobileNumber.description: Mobile phone number for business contact.

businessNature.description: Nature or type of business activity/industry.

ConversionDetails.description: Detailed breakdown of currency conversion including exchange rates and amounts for multi-currency transactions.

effectiveTransactionValue.description: The final value of the transaction after all conversions and fees.

marketExchangeRate.description: The current market exchange rate between the source and destination currencies.

clientRate.description: The exchange rate offered to the client (may include markup).

calizaRate.description: The exchange rate component retained by Caliza.

integratorRate.description: The exchange rate component allocated to the integrator.

CopAccountDto.description: Colombian Peso (COP) bank account details for transfers in Colombia.

accountType.description: Type of bank account (1 = Savings, 2 = Checking).

bankCode.description: Colombian bank code identifying the financial institution.

thirdPartyWithdrawal.description: Indicates if withdrawals to third parties are allowed.

email.description: Email address associated with the account.

CvuAccountDto.description: CVU (Clave Virtual Uniforme) account details for instant transfers in Argentina.

recipientName.description: Full name of the account holder as registered with the CVU.

cvu.description: 22-digit CVU identifier for the recipient account.

ExpectedSettlementTimeDetails.description: Information about expected settlement time for a transaction.

displayText.description: Human-readable settlement time description to display to end users.

additionalInfo.description: Additional context or conditions affecting settlement time.

cutoffTime.description: Cutoff time for same-day settlement in ISO 8601 format.

FeeDetails.description:
Comprehensive breakdown of all fees applied to a transaction:
- taxes: Tax amount charged on the transaction (e.g., IOF in Brazil, VAT, etc.)
- integratorFee: Fee amount allocated to the integrator
- fixedFees: List of fixed fees charged regardless of transaction amount
- percentageFees: List of fees calculated as a percentage of the transaction amount
- spreadFees: List of fees derived from exchange rate spreads in currency conversions
- oldFees: Legacy fee structure (deprecated)
- totalFees: Sum of all fees charged on this transaction
- vet: VET (Valor Efetivo Total) - Brazilian total effective value including all costs

fixedFees.description: List of fixed fees charged regardless of transaction amount.

percentageFees.description: List of fees calculated as a percentage of the transaction amount.

spreadFees.description: List of fees derived from exchange rate spreads in currency conversions.

vet.description: VET (Valor Efetivo Total) - Brazilian total effective value including all costs.

FiatAccountDto.description: Fiat currency bank account information including account type, ownership, and detailed banking information for various payment rails.

id.description: Unique identifier of the fiat account.

name.description: Display name or nickname for the account.

beneficiaryId.description: ID of the beneficiary who owns this account (if applicable).

integratorId.description: ID of the integrator associated with this account.

belongsToBeneficiary.description: Indicates whether this account belongs to a beneficiary (true) or integrator (false).

FixedFeeItemResponse.description: Details of a fixed fee charged on a transaction, independent of transaction amount.

currencyCode.description: Currency in which the fee is charged.

concept.description: Human-readable description of what the fee covers.

paymentRail.description: Payment method this fee applies to.

chargeMode.description: How the fee is applied (DEDUCT = deducted from amount, ADD = added to total).

LocalTargetBankAccountDto.description: Local bank account details for a beneficiary in their domestic country, supporting multiple countries and payment systems.

NFBlockchainInfoDto.description: Blockchain network information for crypto transactions including transaction hashes and wallet addresses.

depositTransactionHash.description: Blockchain transaction hash for the deposit transaction.

withdrawalTransactionHash.description: Blockchain transaction hash for the withdrawal/payout transaction.

fundingWallet.description: Wallet address used to fund the transaction.

NFLocalInfoDto.description: Local payment network information for SPEI, PIX, and other domestic payment systems.

speiInClabe.description: CLABE (Clave Bancaria Estandarizada) for incoming SPEI transfers in Mexico.

speiInBankName.description: Name of the bank for incoming SPEI transfers.

speiInBeneficiaryName.description: Beneficiary name for incoming SPEI transfers.

pixCopyAndPaste.description: PIX copy-and-paste code (QR code text equivalent) for payment.

pixExpiresAt.description: Expiration date and time for the PIX payment code.

targetPixKey.description: PIX key (CPF, CNPJ, email, phone, or random key) for the recipient.

pixOutSearchableId.description: Searchable identifier for outgoing PIX transactions.

speiOutSearchableId.description: Searchable identifier for outgoing SPEI transactions.

uetr.description: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference for SWIFT/wire transfers (ISO 20022).

achTraceNumber.description: Nacha trace number for ACH transfers. Fifteen digits: an 8-digit ODFI routing prefix followed by a 7-digit sequence. For inbound ACH it carries the originating bank's prefix.

achSecCode.description: ACH Standard Entry Class code identifying the type of ACH entry (e.g. CCD for business, PPD for consumer).

achEffectiveDate.description: The effective settlement date for the ACH entry.

NFTransferWalletDto.description: Cryptocurrency wallet information for blockchain-based transfers.

tag.description: Destination tag or memo (required for some networks like Stellar, XRP).

provider.description: Wallet service provider or custody solution.

OldFeeItemResponse.description: Legacy fee structure format (deprecated). Use FixedFeeItemResponse, PercentageFeeItemResponse, or SpreadFeeItemResponse for new integrations.

feeCurrency.description: Currency in which the fee is charged.

effectiveRate.description: Effective rate after spread (for FX fees).

PayInSenderResponse.description: Information about the payment rail and sender details for pay-in transactions.

paymentRails.description: Payment method or rail used for the transaction.

details.description: Additional sender-specific details (structure varies by payment rail).

PercentageFeeItemResponse.description: Details of a percentage-based fee calculated as a portion of the transaction amount.

percentageRate.description: Fee percentage rate in decimal form (e.g., 0.025 = 2.5%).

baseAmount.description: Transaction amount used as the base for percentage calculation.

calculatedFee.description: Calculated fee amount based on the percentage and base amount.

feeCurrency.description: Currency in which the fee is charged.

concept.description: Human-readable description of what the fee covers.

PersonInfo.description: Individual person account information for wire transfers including personal details and bank account information.

PixAccountDto.description: PIX account details for instant payments in Brazil.

pixKey.description: PIX key identifier. Can be CPF, CNPJ, email, phone number (+55...), or random key (UUID).

SpeiAccountDto.description: SPEI (Sistema de Pagos Electrónicos Interbancarios) account details for electronic transfers in Mexico.

clabe.description: 18-digit CLABE (Clave Bancaria Estandarizada) number identifying the Mexican bank account.

receiverName.description: Full name of the account holder as registered with the bank.

SpreadFeeItemResponse.description: Details of fees derived from exchange rate spread in currency conversion transactions.

marketRate.description: Current market exchange rate between the two currencies.

spreadBasisPoint.description: Spread markup in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

effectiveRate.description: Final exchange rate applied after spread.

calizaRate.description: Exchange rate component retained by Caliza.

baseAmount.description: Amount in base currency used for fee calculation.

feeCurrency.description: Currency in which the spread fee is expressed.

concept.description: Human-readable description of the spread fee.

chargeMode.description: How the fee is applied to the transaction.

SwiftAccountDto.description: SWIFT international wire transfer account details supporting both individual and business accounts.

isPobo.description: Indicates if this account uses Pay-on-Behalf-Of (POBO) arrangement where payments are made on behalf of another entity.

pobo.description: Indicates if POBO (Pay-on-Behalf-Of) services are enabled for this account.

SwiftBankInfo.description: Bank information for SWIFT international wire transfers including SWIFT code and bank address.

swiftCode.description: SWIFT/BIC code identifying the bank (8 or 11 characters).

name.description: Full legal name of the bank.

street1.description: Primary street address of the bank.

SwiftBusinessInfo.description: Business account information for SWIFT international wire transfers.

city.description: City where the business is located.

routingNumber.description: Bank routing number or sort code.

SwiftPersonInfo.description: Individual person account information for SWIFT international wire transfers including IBAN details.

name.description: Full name of the account holder.

routingKey.description: Bank routing key or sort code.

email.description: Email address of the account holder.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the account holder.

identificationType.description: Type of identification document (e.g., PASSPORT, ID_CARD, DRIVING_LICENSE).

identificationIssuer.description: Issuing authority or country of the identification document.

occupation.description: Occupation or profession of the account holder.

TargetInfoResponse.description: Information about the target account and source of funds for a transaction.

targetId.description: Identifier of the target account receiving the funds.

fundsTarget.description: Specifies which account type is the destination for the funds.

TransactionDetailsResponse.description: Detailed information about a transaction including conversion details, fees, and settlement expectations.

transferPurpose.description: Purpose or reason for the transfer.

paymentReference.description: Reference number or code for the payment.

memo.description: Additional notes or memo for the transaction.

WireAccountDto.description: Domestic wire transfer account details for U.S. transfers supporting both individual and business accounts.
